description: A single weight-1 keyword match ('api') must yield confidence below the 0.55 escalation threshold so the item is sent for model judgment rather than locked into the tightest band.
rationale: Bug: previously confidence=1.0 because share=1.0 and margin=1.0 for any uncontested match, ignoring the absolute score. Fix folds abs_saturation (top/3 clamped to 1) into the formula so a lone weight-1 hit yields ~0.33.

description: A strong multi-signal high-tier match (CRUD + boilerplate) must still read as high confidence and NOT escalate.
rationale: Regression guard: the abs_saturation fix must not collapse confidence for legitimately strong signals.

description: A weight-2 medium signal ('integrate the webhook') should produce confidence >= 0.55 and NOT escalate.
rationale: A weight-2 match gives abs_saturation=0.667, which multiplied by share+margin terms still clears the 0.55 threshold.

description: An item without the 'E_legacy' key must produce a friendly InvalidELegacyError, not a KeyError stack trace.
rationale: SKILL.md contract: 'if a value is non-numeric, ask the user to clarify that row.' Previously this raised a raw KeyError.

description: A non-numeric 'E_legacy' value must produce a friendly InvalidELegacyError naming the bad value, not a ValueError stack trace.
rationale: Previously float(item['E_legacy']) threw a raw ValueError with no guidance for the user.

description: CLI must exit non-zero with a human-readable 'error:' line when E_legacy is non-numeric — no traceback.
rationale: Validates the CLI exception handler catches InvalidELegacyError alongside MissingDescriptionError.

description: High-tier item with per-item C=0.20 via the documented API (tau stays at tier-preset 0.10) must produce low=38.2, mid=39.4, high=40.6, delta=-2%. This is the reproducible API result for the SKILL.md example-4 headline: the same high-leverage task collapses from -42% to -2% purely by dropping C.

args.description: Add CRUD endpoints for the settings module

rationale: Documented API: per-item C=0.20 overrides only C; tau stays at high-tier preset 0.10. Formula: L_eff=0.75*0.20=0.15, bracket=0.30+0.70*0.85=0.895, E_mid=40*0.895*1.10=39.38≈39.4, delta=-2%. τ is a tier-level calibration, not a per-item input — no tau_override path exists in the API.

description: convert_batch with a per-item C=0.20 override on a high-tier item must use the overridden C, not the preset default C=0.90. The output must differ from the no-override run.

args.description: Add CRUD endpoints for the settings module

rationale: Without C override, high-tier mid ≈ 23 (−42%). With C=0.20 and default tau=0.10, mid ≈ 39 (−2%). Override is applied.

description: A C override outside (0, 1] must produce a friendly InvalidELegacyError, not an unguarded float.

expect.message_contains: Please supply a decimal between 0 (exclusive) and 1 (inclusive)

rationale: C=1.5 or C=0.0 would silently produce nonsense output. Validation catches it with a user-facing message.

description: C=0.0 is invalid (exclusive lower bound). Must raise InvalidELegacyError.

expect.message_contains: Please supply a decimal between 0 (exclusive) and 1 (inclusive)

rationale: C=0 would yield L_eff=0 (zero leverage) which is valid semantically but excluded to avoid a common off-by-one input error.

description: Without C override, a high-tier item must still produce the expected −42% result (preset C=0.90, tau=0.10).

args.description: Add CRUD endpoints and DTOs for the settings API

rationale: Regression guard: per-item C override must not change behavior when C is absent from the item.
